claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four takes place at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, NV.
The semifinals of the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four take place on Thursday, April 9.
The championship of the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four takes place on Saturday, April 11.
Semifinal 1 of the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four is North Dakota vs. Wisconsin at 5:00 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9 on ESPN2.
Semifinal 2 of the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four is Michigan vs. Denver at 8:30 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9 on ESPN2.
The championship of the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four is at 5:30 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11 on ESPN.
The semifinal matchups of the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four are No. 2 North Dakota vs. Wisconsin and No. 1 Michigan vs. Denver.
The teams in the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four are Michigan, Denver, North Dakota, and Wisconsin.
All games of the 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four are available on ESPN networks and the ESPN App.
